PRIVATE MARKETS CEO BRIEFING #01

>> Capital is back — but highly selective << 

Private capital is returning to specific segments: scalable infrastructure, operational buy-and-build strategies, institutional tokenisation and companies with genuine strategic relevance.

Five developments CEOs and investors should watch:

1. Fresh capital for DACH buy-and-build

VALU Invest raised approximately EUR 80 million in equity and now has more than EUR 214 million available for established DACH SMEs.

Its focus on succession, fragmented markets and technology-enabled transformation confirms that Mittelstand consolidation remains a strong private-equity theme.
